title: A Crib for the Daughter and Pastries for Gulya

scenes.title: Late-Night Pastries in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Ainura convinces Gulya to take leftover pastries that would be thrown out in the morning, while Lyova secretly watches them.

scenes.title: The Apartment Key and the Baby Crib
scenes.summary: Tanya and little Alisa guilt Chef Barinov into taking Vika's apartment keys to assemble the baby crib and hang shelves.

scenes.title: Lyova's Gift and the New Father
scenes.summary: Lyova leaves a pastry gift for Gulya, and Max celebrates becoming a father with the entire kitchen crew.

scenes.title: Chef Sends Max to Assemble the Crib
scenes.summary: When Max asks to leave early to celebrate, Chef Barinov hands him the apartment keys and sends him to build his daughter's crib.

scenes.title: Concert Tickets in the Trash
scenes.summary: Katya accidentally throws away a bag containing two Eric Clapton concert tickets that Denis had hidden as a surprise for her.

scenes.title: The Cover Story About a Husband and Kids
scenes.summary: Gulya fears Lyova will fire her over the pastries, so Ainura tells her to claim she has a husband and children to support.

scenes.title: Video Games Instead of the Crib
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov catches Max playing video games instead of building the baby crib and leaves the kitchen to go help him.

scenes.title: A Guitarist for the Evening and Nursery Shelves
scenes.summary: Nikita hires Denis to play Eric Clapton on the guitar for a secret date, while Chef Barinov arrives to hang shelves at Vika's flat.

scenes.title: The Taxi-Driver Neighbor and the Noisy Drill
scenes.summary: An exhausted neighbor who drives a taxi all night bangs on Vika's door demanding that Max and Chef stop drilling.

scenes.title: The Neighbor's Sneaky Help
scenes.summary: The neighbor pretends to apologize for his outburst and tricks Max and Chef into letting him near the baby crib.

scenes.title: Denis Arrives at a Familiar Courtyard
scenes.summary: Nikita arranges a secret evening meeting with Katya and brings Denis to the hotel courtyard to pay him for playing guitar.

scenes.title: Eleonora's Ban and Double Pay
scenes.summary: Eleonora warns Denis to stay away from Katya, and when Denis tries to back out of the gig, Nikita convinces him to come at midnight.

scenes.title: The Broken Crib and the Locked Door
scenes.summary: The angry neighbor breaks the baby crib and hides behind his locked door while Max and Chef demand money for a replacement.

scenes.title: Smashing the Wrong Taxi
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov smashes a taxi windshield to force the neighbor to pay for the crib, only to learn the taxi belongs to another driver.

scenes.title: Lyova's Confession and Five Children
scenes.summary: When Lyova tries to ask Gulya out over pastries, Gulya claims she has a husband and kids in Kyrgyzstan so he will not fire her.

scenes.title: Gulya Tells the Truth and Tanya Checks the Flat
scenes.summary: Gulya tells Lyova that she is single and only lied out of fear, while Tanya orders Victor and Max to finish preparing Vika's apartment.

scenes.title: A Matter of Life and Death
scenes.summary: Nikita asks Katya to put on a blindfold for his surprise in the dining room, while Timur brings a new crib to Max and Chef.

scenes.title: Eleonora Chases Away the Guitarist
scenes.summary: Eleonora finds Denis with his guitar in the dark dining room and kicks him out right before Nikita brings Katya in.

scenes.title: The Ruined Surprise and the Argument with Mom
scenes.summary: Katya discovers that Eleonora chased Denis out of the restaurant and angrily tells her mother to stop meddling in her life.

scenes.title: Late for the Discharge and Talking with Vika
scenes.summary: Max misses Vika's hospital discharge after assembling the crib all night, and Vika tells him they cannot stay together.
